cards.intent: Full-screen graphic, narrator hidden. Icon entry: drop from top. Cuts in as she says 'Then there's Lewy body dementia...'.

contentHints.title: Lewy Body Dementia
contentHints.fact: Protein deposits cause fluctuating alertness & movement changes

contentHints.title: Frontotemporal Dementia
contentHints.fact: Often appears younger — affects personality & language more than memory

cards.intent: Full-screen graphic, narrator hidden. Two brain icons overlap/crossfade at centre. Cuts in as she says '...many people have mixed dementia...'.

contentHints.title: Mixed Dementia
